Where it began

Manav Jagdusakumar Suthar was born on 3 August 2002 in the Sri Ganganagar district, and he made his way in the game with Rajasthan. His first-class debut came in February 2022, when he was nineteen, in a Ranji Trophy match against Andhra, and his first Twenty20 match followed that October against Madhya Pradesh.

By the summer of 2023 he was wearing India colours of a sort, picked for the India A squad at the Emerging Teams Asia Cup, where his first List A game came against the UAE.

The player

Suthar is a bowling all-rounder: he bowls slow left-arm orthodox spin and bats left-handed. He made people take notice in the 2024–25 Duleep Trophy, playing for India C, when he made 82 against India B and, in another match, took seven wickets in an innings against India D. That year he also had a season with Gujarat Titans in the Indian Premier League.

His Test chance came against Afghanistan in June 2026, at New Chandigarh. He took six for 33 in the first innings and was named player of the match. By November 2026 he had played 3 Tests and taken 23 wickets at 17.35 each, with two five-wicket innings and a ten-wicket match among them.

What made him special

It was a flying start to a Test career. A bowling average of 17.35 after three matches speaks of control and patience, and twice in those three games a good spell grew into five wickets or more.

The batting had a quieter start at the top level: 79 runs from four innings, with a best of 28. Then again, his 82 in the Duleep Trophy showed that the all-rounder label was not just there for decoration.

Away from the middle

In the same month as his Test debut he signed for Warwickshire to play two County Championship matches. He took to English conditions quickly, leaving with 11 wickets, including the first five-wicket haul of his county career. He was back with Warwickshire for the run-in to their 2026 Championship season.

And finally

June 2026 brought him a Test cap, a player-of-the-match award and a county contract in England. Most young cricketers would settle for one of those in a year. He managed all three before the month was out, and somehow found time to pack.
